title: Dark Chocolate Ganache Tart
ingredients: 1 Tbsp unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
1 premade Graham cracker crust, prepared as instructed on box
instructions: Place chocolate chips and butter in a mixing bowl.
In a small sauce pan, bring the heavy cream to a simmer.
Take the heavy cream off the heat and pour into the bowl containing chocolate chips and butter.
Cover immediately with plastic wrap and let is sit for about 5 minutes to allow the chocolate chips and butter to melt.
Discard the plastic wrap and begin stirring with the spatula.
Continue stirring until a smooth and consistent thick brown liquid has formed.
If there are any chunks of chocolate, warm in a double boiler or on low in the microwave oven.
Pour the liquid into the Graham cracker crust and allow to cool overnight at room temperature or 3-4 hours in the refrigerator.
Sprinkle with sea salt and serve.
